name: Xash3D FWGS [anylinux]
description:
Xash3D FWGS is an open-source game engine compatible with Valve's GoldSrc engine (Half-Life 1). Rewritten from scratch, it allows players to run Half-Life, its expansions, and classic community mods natively on modern Linux.

Features:
- Native 64-bit Linux port eliminating the need for Wine or compatibility layers
- Modernized OpenGL renderer with high-resolution widescreen and dynamic lighting support
- Full compatibility with Half-Life, Opposing Force, Blue Shift, and multiplayer mods
- Enhanced physical collision simulation and updated network multiplayer protocol
- Customizable field of view, HUD scaling, and modern gamepad/controller mapping

This is an unofficial AnyLinux AppImage, which is able to work anywhere including glibc and musl. For more info: https://pkgforge-dev.github.io/Anylinux-AppImages/
